description: This file implements a sparse set data structure for efficient storage and manipulation of sets of integers, including operations like union, intersection, difference, and iteration. It defines the 'Sparse' type and associated methods, along with internal 'block' structures and bitwise operations.

classes.name: Sparse
classes.description: A data structure representing a set of integers using a linked list of blocks with bit arrays for efficient set operations.

classes.name: block
classes.description: Internal structure representing a block of bits within the sparse set, linked in a doubly-linked list.

methods.name: popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in a word.

methods.name: nlz
methods.description: Counts the number of leading zeros in a word.

methods.name: ntz
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zeros in a word.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Sets a bit in a block, indicating the presence of an element.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Clears a bit in a block, removing an element.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a bit (element) is present in a block.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if a block has no bits set.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Returns the number of bits set in a block.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum element in a block.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum element in a block, optionally removing it.

methods.name: lowerBound
methods.description: Finds the smallest element >= a given value within a block.

methods.name: forEach
methods.description: Iterates over each element in a block.

methods.name: offsetAndBitIndex
methods.description: Calculates the block offset and bit index for a given element.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first block in the set.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next block in the linked list.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the set is empty.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the set.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Returns the maximum element in the set.

methods.name: Min
methods.description: Returns the minimum element in the set.

methods.name: LowerBound
methods.description: Finds the smallest element >= x in the set.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Returns the block containing a specific offset.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Adds an element to the set.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the set.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the set.

methods.name: TakeMin
methods.description: Removes and returns the smallest element in the set.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an element exists in the set.

methods.name: forEach
methods.description: Applies a function to each element in the set.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the contents of another set into this set.

methods.name: insertBlockBefore
methods.description: Inserts a new block before a specified block.

methods.name: discardTail
methods.description: Removes a block and its successors from the set.

methods.name: IntersectionWith
methods.description: Intersects the set with another set.

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Sets the set to the intersection of two sets.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Checks if the set intersects with another set.

methods.name: UnionWith
methods.description: Unites the set with another set.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Sets the set to the union of two sets.

methods.name: DifferenceWith
methods.description: Removes elements present in another set.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Sets the set to the difference of two sets.

methods.name: SymmetricDifferenceWith
methods.description: Sets the set to the symmetric difference with another set.

methods.name: SymmetricDifference
methods.description: Sets the set to the symmetric difference of two sets.

methods.name: SubsetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a subset of another.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two sets are equal.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the set.

methods.name: BitString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the set as bits.

methods.name: GoString
methods.description: Returns a string of the internal representation.

methods.name: AppendTo
methods.description: Appends set elements to a slice.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks internal invariants of the set (for debugging).
